name: pipefail
description: Adds set -o pipefail to a command that pipes a test, typecheck or lint run into tail, head or grep, so a failing run cannot exit 0 and read as a pass.

extraRunners.title: Extra runners
extraRunners.description: Script names that also count as runners when called through a package manager (yarn <name>, npm run <name>, pnpm <name>, bun run <name>), such as a repo's own check script.
